Let \(A=(0,0)\), \(D=(3,0)\), \(B=(x,h)\), \(C=(x+18,h)\).

Since \(AM:MC=1:2\),
\[
M=A+\frac13(C-A)=\left(\frac{x+18}{3},\frac h3\right).
\]

Point \(N\) lies on \(BD\) at the same height \(y=\frac h3\). Parametrize \(BD\):
\[
B+s(D-B)=(x+s(3-x), h(1-s)).
\]
Set \(h(1-s)=\frac h3\), so \(s=\frac23\). Thus
\[
N=\left(x+\frac23(3-x),\frac h3\right)
=\left(\frac{x+6}{3},\frac h3\right).
\]
Therefore,
\[
MN=\frac{x+18}{3}-\frac{x+6}{3}=\frac{12}{3}=4.
\]

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
